intro: Viswaasa Vanithalam is the latest Telugu Christian song written & produced by Joshua Shaik, Passion For Christ Ministries, tuned by Kavitha Shaik sung by Sameera Bharadwaj, Sireesha B, Sreesha, Madhuri and music composed by Thrahimam fame, Pranam Kamalakar.
